dispositions.observation: `WindowKey` serialization is deliberately non-injective for `.origin("combined")` versus `.combined`, and for associated values containing colons. That ambiguity largely mirrors the old string convention, but direct enum construction now makes otherwise-unrepresentable distinctions possible. Tests currently cover only unambiguous values and would benefit from explicitly documenting these reserved-value constraints.
